strats.name: Legion
strats.sum: Big burst-damage check: break frozen generals and sergeants fast for splinters, Incubators and Timeless Emblems. GGG said Legion and Abyss currently lead raw currency per hour.
tips: Spec the rebuilt Legion cluster before buying more Threads.
Corrupt maps for extra mods (3.30 adds 2 mods, up to 9) only if your build clears reflect-free.
Need fast single-target burst; slow ramp-up builds lose most of the value.

strats.name: Abyss
strats.sum: Follow the cracks and pop Abyssal Depths. Rewards raw currency and Abyss jewels; one of the two top raw-currency mechanics per GGG.
tips: Clear speed matters more than bossing.
Note Alluring Abyss left the Atlas in 3.30, so value comes from the pits and Depths themselves.

strats.name: Expedition
strats.sum: Plan explosive chains for logbooks and artifacts. Weaker raw currency than Legion/Abyss, but feeds Gwennen's new coin-flip crafting (Astragali + Broken Circle Artifacts).
tips: Good for slower builds: you set the pace.
Stockpile Broken Circle Artifacts for Gwennen's paired crafting options.

strats.name: Ritual
strats.sum: Fight in altars, save tribute for deferred rewards. The King in the Mists always drops an ilvl 85–86 Ritual base, great for crafting.
tips: Blood-Filled Vessels now need Ritual Threads.
Tanky builds shine: monsters are revived on top of you.

strats.name: Breach
strats.sum: Dense packs and splinters. Easy and fun with fast AoE, but behind Legion/Abyss in GGG's raw-currency comparison.
tips: Pure clear: walk the circle, don't stop.
Pair with an Abyss Thread for extra mob density.

strats.name: Harvest (in-map flora)
strats.sum: No more grove: Sacred Flora spawns directly in maps. Activate it for Sacred Fauna and Lifeforce; high tiers can roll a Sacred Specimen boss.
tips: Lifeforce funds the cheaper 3.30 resist swaps (300 of two types).
Great side-income for any build; layer it under a Thread strategy.

strats.name: Essence
strats.sum: Secondary Essence cluster. Low requirement, and feeds essence-spam crafting. Essences sell steadily.
tips: Weeping/Wailing essences no longer spawn in yellow/red maps.
New: Essence of Trickery.

strats.name: Strongbox
strats.sum: Strongboxes now drop Threads, so this cluster sustains your Thread supply for other strategies.
tips: Use it to self-fund Threads early.
Arcanist/Cartographer-style boxes still need a build that survives waves.

strats.name: Covens & Fates (league)
strats.sum: Interrupt a coven's ritual, then pick a Fate for the area boss. Empowered bosses drop Viscera for your Wickerman, granting a piece of the boss's power.
tips: Only stack Fates you can kill fast; each adds difficulty.
Strong bossers can farm this alongside any Thread strategy.

strats.name: Ultimatum
strats.sum: Rewards keep improving after round 10 in 3.30 instead of capping. High risk, high reward for very tanky builds.
tips: Avoid if you die to ruin or stone circles.
Push past 10 only when the offered reward justifies it.

strats.name: Blight
strats.sum: Tower defence: towers do the work, so it suits weak or slow characters. Oils sell and anoint.
tips: Any build can run it.
Great early when gear is thin.

strats.name: Unwavering Vision (late game)
strats.sum: Keystone that limits you to one Thread type but grants two bonus Threads past the 8 cap. The endgame scaler for your best mechanic.
tips: Take it once your main strategy is fully specced.
Higher Thread counts raise the chance of transformative effects.

progressTips.p1: Your Atlas opens after the Epilogue.
progressTips.p2: Use bench crafts and Harvest resist swaps to fix gaps.
progressTips.p3: Run the 10 Shaped Regions for free Threads; finishing a region objective adds 1 free Thread to its other maps.
progressTips.p4: Rule of thumb: 3.5k+ life/ES pool and ~300k DPS.
progressTips.p5: Rule of thumb: 4.5k+ pool, 1M+ DPS, chaos res above 0.
progressTips.p6: 3.30 doubles the point reward for this quest.
progressTips.p7: Eater altars can now drop Breach, Legion, Blight, Ritual or Incursion Threads.
progressTips.p8: Each Invitation is now worth 2 Skill and 2 Respec points.
progressTips.p9: Memory game: practise it in a safe league or watch a guide first.
progressTips.p10: Worth 4 Skill and 2 Respec points in 3.30.
progressTips.p11: Atziri moved into the Temple of Atzoatl and was redesigned.

physref.label: Monsters reflect Physical Damage
physref.why: Your hits are physical and you deal them yourself.

eleref.label: Monsters reflect Elemental Damage
eleref.why: Your hits are elemental and you deal them yourself.

noleech.label: Cannot Leech from Monsters
noleech.why: Your gear or gems use leech for recovery.

maxres.label: Players have − to all maximum Resistances
maxres.why: Hurts every build; brutal in red maps.

lessrec.label: Players have less Recovery Rate
lessrec.why: Cuts your life/ES recovery when you are already squishy.

hexproof.label: Monsters are Hexproof
hexproof.why: Your build relies on curses or marks.

tc.label: Players are Cursed with Temporal Chains
tc.why: Slows everything, including flasks and recovery.

crit.label: Monsters have increased Critical Strike Chance
crit.why: Spiky damage against a small life pool.

buffs.label: Buffs on Players expire faster
buffs.why: Shortens charges and buffs you rely on.
